evidence: Sort by Priority shows order: Review project proposal(High), Complete tax filing(High), Submit final report(High), Schedule dentist appointment(Medium), Buy groceries(Low) - High before Medium before Low.

Sort by Deadline order: Buy groceries(Tomorrow/Aug25), Review project proposal(Aug26), Submit final report(Aug29), Schedule dentist appointment(Aug31), Complete tax filing(Sep7), QA Alpha No Deadline(no deadline, placed last) - ascending order with no-deadline tasks after dated ones.
Created task "QA Alpha No Deadline" with only title; active count increased from 5 to 6, task shown in active list.
Created "QA Beta Full Details" with description, deadline Sep 15, Low priority, prerequisite "QA Alpha No Deadline"; all details retained and displayed on the card after creation.

issue: Blocked task's edit control is fully disabled, not partially restricted
actual: For blocked task "QA Beta Full Details" (prerequisite "QA Alpha No Deadline" incomplete), the edit button is rendered fully disabled (aria-disabled/disabled attribute) and clicking it produces no dialog or any UI change. Users cannot modify description or priority at all while blocked, contradicting the requirement that description and priority remain editable.

evidence: Selected "QA Alpha No Deadline" as prerequisite for "QA Beta Full Details" during creation; saved task displays "Prerequisite \"QA Alpha No Deadline\" incomplete" confirming dependency was recorded and displayed.

"QA Beta Full Details" and "Complete tax filing" (blocked by incomplete prerequisites) show disabled complete-toggle buttons and warning labels; unblocked tasks like "Review project proposal" have enabled complete buttons.

Single-prerequisite blocked task "Complete tax filing" shows 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'; multi-prerequisite blocked task "Submit final report" shows '2 prerequisites incomplete'.

Edited "QA Alpha No Deadline": changed title to "QA Alpha Updated Title", added description/deadline(Oct1)/changed priority to Medium/added prerequisite "Buy groceries" - all saved and displayed. Then deleted the task; active count dropped 7->6 and task removed from list; dependent task "QA Beta Full Details" correctly became unblocked (prerequisite label removed, complete button enabled).

In the Edit dialog for "QA Alpha No Deadline" (a prerequisite of "QA Beta Full Details"), "QA Beta Full Details" was absent from the prerequisite checkbox list, preventing selection that would create a cycle (Beta->Alpha->Beta).
Completed "Review project proposal" via its toggle button; active count decreased 6->5, completed count increased 2->3, task disappeared from Active view and appeared in Completed view.

Switching to Completed tab shows only completed tasks (Reply to client emails, Review project proposal, Organize desk) with count "Completed 3" matching header "5 active, 3 completed"; Active tab shows only active tasks with count "5".

"Complete tax filing" (blocked, complete disabled) became completable once its prerequisite "Review project proposal" was completed ("1 prerequisite completed", complete button enabled). After completing it, "Submit final report" (which had 2 prerequisites) also became eligible, showing "2 prerequisites completed" with complete button enabled.

Tasks display title+priority always (e.g. "QA Alpha No Deadline" showed only title/priority); description and deadline shown when supplied (e.g. "QA Beta Full Details"); blocking prerequisite state shown via warning text; completed tasks rendered with CSS "line-through" text-decoration and muted color class, visually distinguishing from active tasks.
Typing only whitespace ("   ") into the Title field keeps "Create Task" button disabled, preventing submission; task list remains unchanged (4 active, 4 completed).

Completed tasks ("Review project proposal", "Complete tax filing") remained visible in the Completed view (not deleted) after completion, and reopening via toggle button successfully returned "Review project proposal" to the Active view.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves dependent task in an invalid completed+blocked state
actual: "Complete tax filing" was completed while its prerequisite "Review project proposal" was also completed. After reopening "Review project proposal" (uncompleting it), "Complete tax filing" remained in the Completed view/count (Completed 3, task still listed there and not moved to Active view/count which stayed at 5, unchanged by this task) yet simultaneously displayed the blocked-state UI: a disabled reopen/toggle button and the warning "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete". The system neither prevented reopening the prerequisite nor moved the dependent task back to a valid incomplete/active state - it is left completed and blocked at the same time.

evidence: Hovering the "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" warning label on the blocked task "Submit final report" opens a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing "Review project proposal" as pending and "Complete tax filing" in the chain, identifying which prerequisite is pending.

issue: Hovering the visual dependency connector line shows no popup
actual: A dashed-line connector (div.bg-dashed-line, plus an underlying SVG dashed path with the same geometry) visually links the "Review project proposal" card to the dependent "Submit final report" card. Directly hovering this visible connector element (confirmed via a real Playwright hover interaction) produced no tooltip, popup, or any dependency-chain information - the accessibility tree remained unchanged with no tooltip/popover content, unlike hovering the prerequisite warning label (IX-20) which does show the chain.
